scripts.types:generate: json2ts -i ../schemas -o src/types/generated --bannerComment '/* Generated from schemas/. Do not edit — run npm run types:generate */'
scripts.types:check: rm -rf .types-check && json2ts -i ../schemas -o .types-check --bannerComment '/* Generated from schemas/. Do not edit — run npm run types:generate */' && diff -r .types-check src/types/generated && rm -rf .types-check
